title: Inventive AI vs AutoRFP (2026): Which AI RFP Software Fits Your Team?
summary: Inventive AI vs AutoRFP compared on accuracy, content governance, UI, pricing, and G2 reviews, plus what teams found running both on the same live RFPs.
body_markdown:
Inventive AI and AutoRFP.ai are both AI-native request for proposal (RFP) platforms with unlimited users. Inventive AI is an AI-native RFP platform that drafts cited answers from your connected company knowledge and flags conflicting or outdated content before it reaches a buyer. AutoRFP.ai drafts from an approved content library synced from your systems and prices by project. On a feature checklist they look close. The difference shows when the same live RFP runs through both: answer accuracy, how conflicting content gets caught, and whether the team actually enjoys using the tool.


## Inventive AI vs AutoRFP: the short answer


- **Choose Inventive AI:** for cited answers with a confidence score, automatic conflict detection, live-synced sources, and agents for competitive analysis and a positioning brief on every RFP. Ripple piloted both on live RFPs and chose Inventive AI on accuracy.
- **Choose AutoRFP:** for published, project-capped pricing, Go/No-Go screening against custom criteria, ISO 27001 certification, and onboarding bundled into every tier.


## How do Inventive AI and AutoRFP compare side by side?


Both draft fast. Inventive AI pulls ahead on governance, accuracy you can audit, and work beyond drafting, while AutoRFP leads on published pricing and certifications.

## How do Inventive AI and AutoRFP compare on features?


Inventive AI leads on accuracy, governance, ease of use, and strategy work. AutoRFP leads on published pricing and its ISO 27001 certification.


### Is Inventive AI or AutoRFP more accurate?


Inventive AI gives answers teams can audit line by line.


- **AutoRFP:** drafts from an uploaded library, with citations and a Trust Score on each answer.
- **Inventive AI:** drafts from live-synced sources, cites the exact passage, scores confidence from 0 to 100%, and flags gaps instead of guessing.
- **Proof:** Ripple's one rule for its January 2026 head-to-head pilot was whether the tool makes things up, and it chose Inventive AI after hundreds of questions. When[Ironclad](https://www.inventive.ai/case-studies/ironclad) fact-checked an exported Inventive AI questionnaire with Glean, 96 to 97% of answers checked out.


### Is Inventive AI or AutoRFP easier to use?


Inventive AI is rated #1 Easiest to Use in G2's RFP category, and ease of use is its most-mentioned strength, in 58 G2 reviews. AutoRFP's most common G2 complaints run the other way: an interface reviewers don't find especially intuitive, and screens that are hard to navigate.


### Which handles content governance better, Inventive AI or AutoRFP?


Inventive AI flags duplicates and contradictions in real time, archives them in one click, and traces every answer to its source document.[Harte Hanks](https://www.inventive.ai/customer-stories/case-studies/harte-hanks-replaced-legacy-rfp-automation-responsive-and-chatgpt-with-one-ai-rfp-response-platform-now-used-across-6-lines-of-business) uses this to keep outdated answers out of proposals entirely, and customers report content maintenance running 70% faster. The[Knowledge Hub](https://www.inventive.ai/features/knowledge-hub) stays current because it syncs with the documents teams already update.


### Which helps more with bid strategy, Inventive AI or AutoRFP?


Both support go/no-go, and Inventive AI goes further on positioning.


- **AutoRFP:** Go/No-Go analysis scores each RFP against custom deal-breaker criteria, with a confidence score.
- **Inventive AI:**[strategic agents](https://www.inventive.ai/features/agents) support go/no-go, run competitive analysis, build a positioning brief for each RFP, and check compliance.
- **The gap:** AutoRFP doesn't list competitor research, so positioning work happens outside the tool.


### Can Inventive AI and AutoRFP handle high RFP volume?


Both handle high volume, and they scale it differently. AutoRFP's plans cap projects per year (24 on Scale, 50 on Accelerate), with custom Enterprise pricing above that, and G2 reviewers describe running RFPs with hundreds of questions. Inventive AI prices per RFP with unlimited users, and its customers report these volumes:


- [Ripple](https://www.inventive.ai/customer-stories/case-studies/how-ripple-rolled-out-ai-rfp-automation-to-150-people-to-replace-40-hour-manual-rfps-with-70-80-auto-filled-answers) **:** about 500 projects a year, with RFPs up to 750 questions, across 150 users.
- [Druva](https://www.inventive.ai/customer-stories/case-studies/druva-moved-its-entire-60-person-se-org-off-responsive-formerly-rfpio-in-under-a-month-after-a-1-week-pilot-600-rfps-a-year-0-users-going-back) **:** about 600 RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires a year.
- [Cushman & Wakefield](https://www.inventive.ai/case-studies/cushman-wakefield) **:** 500+ proposals a year across 60 countries.


## Pricing and security: Inventive AI vs AutoRFP


Both include unlimited users and hold SOC 2 Type II. AutoRFP prices by project and adds ISO 27001, while Inventive AI costs $830/month, billed annually, and adds zero data retention with its AI providers.


### How do Inventive AI and AutoRFP compare on pricing?


Both charge per project rather than per seat, with unlimited users.


- **AutoRFP:**[AutoRFP pricing](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/autorfp-pricing) is published: Scale at $899/month for 24 projects a year and Accelerate at $1,299/month for 50, billed annually.
- **Inventive AI:** costs $830/month, billed annually, with unlimited users and every feature included.
- **Return:**[AssetWorks](https://www.inventive.ai/case-studies/how-assetworks-facilities-achieved-422-roi-on-rfp-automation-with-inventive-ai) reports a 422% ROI and $105,000 in net savings on Inventive AI.


### How do Inventive AI and AutoRFP compare on security?


Both hold SOC 2 Type II, and each adds different controls.


- **AutoRFP:** adds ISO 27001:2022, SCIM, and regional hosting, and says customer data isn't used to train public AI models.
- **Inventive AI:** adds zero data retention with OpenAI and Anthropic, strict tenant isolation, SAML SSO, and AES-256 encryption, and doesn't use customer data to train generalized AI models. Its hosting providers hold ISO 27001; Inventive AI itself is[SOC 2 Type II](https://www.inventive.ai/security) audited.

## Inventive AI vs AutoRFP: pros and cons from G2 reviews


Both tools hold a 4.9 on G2, from 88 reviews for Inventive AI and 67 for AutoRFP. Reviewers praise Inventive AI most for ease of use and AutoRFP most for time saved. Their top complaints differ: reporting depth for Inventive AI, and navigation for AutoRFP.


### What do G2 reviewers say about Inventive AI?


**Strengths**


- **Ease of use:** the most-mentioned strength, in 58 reviews, with first-time users productive quickly.
- **Accurate, consistent answers:** 30 reviews highlight consistent, context-rich responses, and reviewers say inline citations and confidence scores speed up review.
- **Drafts from existing documentation:** reviewers value pulling from connected sources instead of maintaining one library, plus conflict detection when the same information lives in several places.
- **Portals and qualification:** reviewers fill vendor-portal RFPs in place with the browser extension and use go/no-go analysis at the start.


**Limitations**


- **Analytics and reporting:** the top complaint, with reviewers asking for more filters, visual dashboards, and win-rate reporting without exporting to Excel.
- **Role-based controls:** some reviewers want finer permissions by stage or team and more detailed approval workflows.
- **Export and design:** Designed proposals or slide decks are still finished outside the tool.


### What do G2 reviewers say about AutoRFP?


**Strengths**


- **Time saved:** the most-mentioned strength, in 34 reviews, across RFPs, DDQs, and security questionnaires.
- **Team collaboration:** 19 reviews credit easy question assignment across the business.
- **Responsive support:** 16 reviews praise proactive help during setup.
- **Citations:** reviewers say the recently added AI citations make reviews faster.


**Limitations**


- **Navigation and interface:** the most common complaints, with reviewers finding the interface not especially intuitive and some screens hard to navigate.
- **Library ramp-up:** one reviewer spent the first weeks chasing SMEs and cleaning up an outdated library before drafts improved, and another saw answers pulled from out-of-date responses after product changes.
- **Access and plans:** web-only access, and project caps on the Scale and Accelerate plans.

## When is AutoRFP the better choice?


AutoRFP is the better pick when one of these is true for the team:


- **ISO 27001 is required:** the security review demands it from every vendor.
- **The budget needs a hard cap:** a fixed project count written into the contract matters more than unlimited usage.
- **Positioning happens elsewhere:** the team wants go/no-go screening and drafting in one tool and already handles competitive positioning outside it.


## Which should a proposal team choose: Inventive AI or AutoRFP?


Both are capable AI-first platforms, so the pilot decides it. Ripple ran the same live RFPs through both and chose Inventive AI on accuracy, so a side-by-side test on real work is the fairest way to decide.


**Inventive AI:** best for teams that want governed, cited drafts, a knowledge base that stays current on its own, and strategy agents in the same workflow.


**AutoRFP:** best for small to mid teams that want published, project-capped pricing and need fast qualification and drafting. Teams weighing other options can compare[AutoRFP alternatives](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/autorfp-alternatives) .

## Frequently Asked Questions


### Can a team pilot Inventive AI and AutoRFP at the same time?


Yes. Ripple ran a head-to-head pilot of both before choosing Inventive AI. Comparing first drafts, flagged gaps, and export quality on one real RFP is the fastest way to decide.


### How long does onboarding take on Inventive AI?


Druva's 60-person SE team plus GRC and InfoSec went live in under a month.


### Does either tool train AI models on customer data?


AutoRFP says customer data isn't used to train public AI models. Inventive AI doesn't use customer data to train generalized AI models and runs zero data retention with OpenAI and Anthropic.


### What happens when a project cap runs out on AutoRFP?


AutoRFP's Scale and Accelerate plans include a set number of projects a year, and higher volume moves to custom Enterprise pricing. Ask how over-cap projects are billed before signing.


### Which is better for security questionnaires, Inventive AI or AutoRFP?


Both handle them well. AutoRFP reviewers credit big time savings on long security questionnaires, while Inventive AI reviewers value drafting from existing security documentation and flagging conflicting answers when policies differ across teams.


### Does Inventive AI work with procurement portals?


Yes. It answers Coupa, Ariba, and Jaggaer portal RFPs, and AutoRFP offers a Coupa plug-in.


### Do Inventive AI and AutoRFP offer a free trial?


Both list a free trial on G2. Inventive AI also runs a buyer's own RFP live on the demo call, which shows real draft quality faster than a sandbox.
